info.name: Ansanm Pou Haiti API
info.description:
REST API of the Ansanm Pou Haiti website (WordPress theme).

- Content: `{{baseUrl}}/ansanm-pou-haiti/v1/...`
- Donations (Stripe): `{{baseUrl}}/encoderit-stripe/v1/...`

**Setup:** import an environment (Local or Production), set its secret `apiKey` to the value of `ANSANM_POU_HAITI_REST_API_KEY` from that site's wp-config.php, and select it. Every request sends it as the `x-api-key` header (collection auth). Run folder 1 first: it saves the IDs/offsets later requests use.

Requests that change data are marked in their description (submit form, payments, subscriptions, cancel).

item.name: 1. Pages (get-post-details)
item.description: One request per page template. `get-post-details` returns the page, its ACF fields (`acf_fields`) and, per template, the extra data the website shows on first load. IDs are collection variables (same IDs locally and on production after the content import).

request.description: Front page (front-page.php): all Home Page ACF content in `acf_fields`.

page-project.php: `projects` (cards of the first grid page), `count`, `total_projects`, `pagination` {page, per_page, total_pages, has_more}. Load the next pages with **3. Lists > Projects - next page**.

page-news.php: `featured_post` (the featured story, or the newest), `posts` (rest of the first load), `pagination` {page, first_load_count, load_more_count, total_pages, has_more}. Next stories: **3. Lists > News - load more**.

page-transparency.php: `funding_progress` (raised = offline + Stripe, target, percent), `ledger_columns` (Table Columns settings: heading, fact, display, align, colors, radius, highlight) and `ledger` rows (fixed keys community/status/committed/highlight + `cells`, one per column), `count`, `total_projects`, `pagination`.

page-contact.php: `contact_items` - one per line with label, type (email | phone | whatsapp | text | map), value, link (mailto: / tel: / https://wa.me/...; empty for text), is_link, embed_url (map rows).
page-vision.php: vision_statement, core_values, future_goals, success_stats, join_mission in `acf_fields`.
page-donation.php: page content groups/repeaters in `acf_fields` (the Stripe form itself uses the Stripe endpoints).
Global Settings page: `site_logo_url`, and in `acf_fields` the Theme Settings, Donate Card (`donate_cta`), News Article Labels (`news_single`) and Project Page Labels (`project_single`).
Any page or post can also be looked up by `slug` (with `post_type` page, post or projects).
Same endpoint with a JSON body instead of query parameters.

item.name: 2. Single project & news post
item.description: Detail pages: the full item plus everything its page shows.

query.description: Optional: rejects the call if the ID is another type

request.description: A project: `acf_fields` (tag_line, project_details, card_content), `project_details` (quick facts rows: label, text), `related_projects` (3 "More projects" cards), `project_labels` (back_label, back_link, facts_title, related_title - Global Settings > Project Page Labels) and `donate_cta`.

A news post: `news_facts` (quick facts rows, category first), `related_posts` (3 "More stories"), `news_labels` (back_label, back_link, facts_title, related_title - Global Settings > News Article Labels) and `donate_cta`.
Look a project up by its slug.

item.name: 3. Lists & pagination
item.description: Paginated list for any post type. Parameters: `post_type` (or `type`), `limit` (or `per_page`), `offset` (or `page`), `exclude` (IDs, comma separated), `search` (or `s`), `category` / `category_name`, `orderby`, `order`, `status`. Response: `posts`, `total_posts`, `has_more`.

request.description: Next page of the Projects grid after **Projects page**: limit = pagination.per_page, offset = projects already received (both saved by that request). Items have the same shape as `projects`.
Next stories after **News page**: exclude the featured story, limit = pagination.load_more_count, offset = non-featured posts already received (all saved by that request).
Keyword search with a category filter.
Same as above with a JSON body.
Alias of get-paginated-posts.
Every item of a post type (no pagination). Parameters: `post_type` (or `type`), `limit` / `per_page`, `search` / `s`, `status`.

item.name: 4. Contact form (Forminator)
item.description: The contact form (Forminator form 47; the form ID is fixed on the server).

request.description: Field list (ids, types, labels, required, options) to build the form.
**Creates a real entry** (and sends the form's notification e-mails). Send the field ids from **Get form fields** as keys, either at the top level or inside `fields`.

item.name: 5. Stripe donations
item.description: `payments` and `subscriptions` POST accept the `x-api-key` header (app) or a reCAPTCHA token (website). Status / cancel calls need the `status_access_token` returned when the payment or subscription was created, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (saved automatically). Use **test** mode keys while trying these: they create real Stripe objects.

request.description: Publishable key, currency, mode (test/live), custom amount limits.
Active donation amounts (each row is a product + its one price): one_time and recurring (monthly). Saves the first one-time and first monthly price ID.
Custom amount in dollars (e.g. 25 or 25.50; min/max from the Stripe settings). Returns client_secret (confirm with Stripe.js / mobile SDK), payment_reference and status_access_token (saved).
One of the preset amounts, by its one-time price ID (from **Products & prices**).
Status of a payment by its payment_reference (re-checked with Stripe while not succeeded). Authorization: Bearer status_access_token (or ?token=).
Monthly donation by a recurring price ID (from **Products & prices**). Returns client_secret, subscription_reference and status_access_token (saved).
Status, current period and cancellation of a subscription by its subscription_reference. Authorization: Bearer status_access_token.
**Cancels the subscription in Stripe immediately.** Authorization: Bearer status_access_token.

item.name: 6. Stripe webhook (Stripe calls this)
item.description: Called by Stripe, not by apps. It only accepts events signed with the webhook secret (Stripe-Signature header), so a hand-made request is rejected (400) - that is the expected result. To test real events use the Stripe CLI: `stripe listen --forward-to {{baseUrl}}/encoderit-stripe/v1/webhook` and `stripe trigger payment_intent.succeeded`.

request.description: Unsigned request: expected to be rejected.
